question: Which Indian model was crowned Miss World in November 2017?
solution: The correct answer is __**Manushi Chhillar**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Manushi Chhillar**, an Indian model and beauty queen, was crowned **Miss World** on **18th November 2017** at the event held in **Sanya, China**. • She is the **sixth Indian** to win the prestigious title of Miss World, following notable winners like **Aishwarya Rai** (1994) and **Priyanka Chopra** (2000). • Manushi Chhillar represented the state of **Haryana** in the competition, showcasing her talent, intelligence, and social initiatives. • Her winning answer in the Q&A round focused on the significance of **mothers’ contributions** to society, resonating deeply with the judges and audience. • She actively promoted her project titled **"Project Shakti,"** aimed at spreading awareness about menstrual hygiene among women in India.
